material.head: A* setup: wave 2 of wave 3
material.text: Five clean waves up from Mar 30 to Aug 5 (+55%, wave 1). The pullback turned up from the 0.618–0.786 zone of that advance (−13% to −19%), in three waves, with the 50-day average and the 200-week average in the same place. It is the second wave of a larger wave 3: five waves up from Aug 7, 2025 to Jan 16 and a pullback of 0.79 of them to the Mar 30 low came first, so the end of this wave 2 starts wave 3 of 3, the strongest move a chart makes. The count is wrong under the start of wave 1 (−28%); a close over the wave-1 high (+12%) says wave 3 is under way.
material.learn: After five waves up the pullback usually ends between the 0.618 and 0.786 retracement of the advance; a close turning up there is the buy.

material.learn: Two lows at one price with a peak between; the pattern counts once price closes over that peak.
